# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

## At the Speed of Science

Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories in Lincoln, NE and Zurich, Switzerland are equipped with the
latest technologies for PK, immunogenicity, and biomarker assays to provide regulated support at all
phases of drug development.

[Learn More][147]

## Bioanalytical Sciences

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug
developers from pre-clinical through late-stage clinical testing. Learn how our experienced
scientific teams can provide custom, phase-appropriate bioanalytical solutions for your program.

CLINICAL RESEARCH SPOTLIGHT

## The Future of Pharmacy

We’ve got our eyes set on the future. We’re taking research higher, discoveries further, and
translating science into medicine day by day.

[Learn More][155]

## Therapeutic Expertise Areas

### Focused on Strong Science and Flawless Execution

Between our comprehensive services and decades of therapeutic experience, we have the expertise to
handle every aspect of your product’s early development—no matter the type of drug or clinical
trial. These are some of the many specialties we’ve cultivated over the years, to provide fast,
innovative solutions for your drug’s development.

## What Sets Us Apart

[AGILE ICON][AGILE ICON]

#### AGILE

Speed is part of our name. We optimize our studies for speed and efficiency at every stage, to
generate actionable data faster than our competitors.

[EXPERIENCED ICON][EXPERIENCED ICON]

#### EXPERIENCED

Our 50+ years of experience conducting 6,000+ studies ensures the collection of quality data through
efficient and effective study designs.

[GLOBAL ICON][GLOBAL ICON]

#### GLOBAL

With facilities across North America, Europe, and Asia, in 30 countries worldwide, we conduct trials
with the right patients, in the right places, to get the data you need.

[INNOVATIVE ICON][INNOVATIVE ICON]

#### INNOVATIVE

From data acquisition strategies to advanced facilities, we lead the way in leveraging new
technology to provide faster, more accurate data, at less cost.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

phases of drug development.

## Bioanalytical Sciences

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug
developers from pre-clinical through late-stage clinical testing. Learn how our experienced

Between our comprehensive services and decades of therapeutic experience, we have the expertise to

Speed is part of our name. We optimize our studies for speed and efficiency at every stage, to
generate actionable data faster than our competitors.

Our 50+ years of experience conducting 6,000+ studies ensures the collection of quality data through

With facilities across North America, Europe, and Asia, in 30 countries worldwide, we conduct trials
with the right patients, in the right places, to get the data you need.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

Areas of Focus

#### Revolutionary medicines enable us to enrich and extend life for people living with all types of
#### diseases. 

[Internal medicine graphical thumbnail portrait image 2]

##### [ Internal Medicine ][109]

[ View All Internal Medicine ][110]

We’re developing therapies to treat, slow, or prevent disease progression and improve the quality of
life for patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular and kidney diseases. 

[Inflammation and Immunology graphical thumbnail portrait image 3]

##### [ Inflammation & Immunology ][111]

[ View All Inflammation & Immunology ][112]

We look for treatments that provide more than just symptom relief, in order to address the root
cause of chronic inflammatory diseases at a molecular level

[Vaccine graphical thumbnail portrait image 4]

##### [ Vaccines ][113]

[ View All Vaccines ][114]

Vaccines are the single most important innovation in the science of health to significantly reduce
the threat of diseases that were once widespread and oftentimes fatal. 

[Vaccines][115] 
[Milestones][116] 
[Pipeline & Clinical Trials ][117]

[Oncology graphical thumbnail portrait image 5]

lives of cancer patients worldwide.

[Oncology][120]

#### Starting with Charles Pfizer inventing an almond-flavored antiparasite medicine in 1849, our
#### people have always been innovators and trailblazers, committed to finding the next cure.

health outcomes.

We combine life-changing diagnostics and medicines to take on the toughest healthcare challenges,

Guided by the experiences of patients, we are determined to prevent, stop and cure diseases so
people can live healthier, longer lives.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

# 
# Delaware

## A strategic location for global business, innovation, opportunity, and access

Are you looking for an opportunity partner? Do you need access to a strategic location in the heart
of the U.S. East Coast? We’re Delaware Prosperity Partnership, working alongside business leaders to
help companies innovate, expand, scale and enter new markets. Discover why Delaware works.

##### **Site Selectors Tools**

[ What Properties are Available? ][89]
[ Delaware Cost of Living ][90]

## ***Business Grows in Delaware***

### Why More and More Businesses Choose Delaware

Business-friendly, lifestyle-diverse Delaware offers a favorable corporate tax climate and a robust
talent pool plus a major port, a major passenger rail hub and access to two international airports. 

##### **Want more info on Delaware?**

Keep up to date on Delaware business news

### News & Announcements

### [DPP names Monique Claiborne Cardwell New President/CEO][91]

[Read more][92]

### [Train Maintenance Company Alstom Chooses Delaware for New $55M Site][93]

[Read more][94]

### [Delaware Financial Services Leadership Strengthened by New Banking Legislation][95]

[Read more][96]

### Corporate Capital of the World

More than two-thirds of Fortune 500 companies are incorporated in Delaware.

### Premier Business Climate

Delaware has the second and third best overall corporate tax favorability in the country for new and
mature firms, respectively.

### Mighty in Innovation

With the most fintech patents per capita, our state has the 6th best environment for innovation.

### Prime Location on the Eastern Seaboard

More than 60 million people live within 300 miles of our state.
* [ New Castle County ][97]
* [ Kent County ][98]
* [ Sussex County ][99]

## New Castle County

In the Heart of It All

Less than 100 miles from New York and Washington, D.C., with easy access to Philadelphia and
Baltimore, New Castle County is home to some of the First State’s largest employers and industry
hubs, including our I-95 innovation corridor.

[Choose New Castle County][100]

## Kent County

Building Business with Room to Grow

Home to Delaware’s state capital since 1717, Kent County boasts nationally recognized institutions
like the Dover Air Force Base and a diverse base of companies, manufacturers, and startups.

[Choose Kent County][101]

## Sussex County

Delaware’s Southern Star

Our fastest-growing county by population, Sussex County offers an economy with continual growth and
diversification and is particularly known for its $1 billion agriculture industry.

[Choose Sussex County][102]

### Why More and More Businesses Choose Delaware

Business-friendly, lifestyle-diverse Delaware offers a favorable corporate tax climate and a robust
talent pool plus a major port, a major passenger rail hub and access to two international airports.

## We lead the NHS in England to deliver high quality services for all

If you are looking for information about health conditions and NHS services please visit
[NHS.uk][16].

[My Planned Care][17] gives you advice and support while you wait and helps you to prepare for your
hospital consultation, treatment, or surgery.

[NHS league tables][18] provide a view of how NHS trusts are performing in key services including
urgent and emergency care, elective services, mental health and more.

[[Doctor examining a patient]][19]

## [The best of the NHS][20]

Every day, NHS colleagues across the country are delivering outstanding care in new and innovative
ways. Discover some of the [best work happening in the NHS][21] right now.

[[A nurse stands by a hospital bed talking to a patient]][22]

## [Medium Term Planning Framework - delivering change together 2026/27 to 2028/29][23]

The [Medium Term Planning Framework – delivering change together 2026/27 to 2028/29][24] is the
NHS’s most ambitious plan in a generation, setting out how waiting times will be dramatically
reduced and local care restored over the next 3 years while resetting the foundations to deliver the
10 Year Health Plan.

### [Digital transformation][25]

Helping health and care professionals communicate better.

### [Elective care][26]

How we are improving experience and giving people choice and control for elective care services.

### [Workforce][27]

How we can put the NHS workforce on a sustainable footing and meet future challenges.

### [Mental health][28]

Improving outcomes and experiences of people with mental health problems.

### [Integrated care][29]

Giving people the support they need and removing disjointed care.

### [Cancer][30]

Making sure everyone with cancer receives care, support and treatment.

### [Urgent and emergency care][31]

Ensuring patients get the right care whenever they need it.

### [Primary care][32]

Offering patients a wider choice of personalised health services.

### [Health inequalities improvement][33]

Tackling health inequalities and advancing equality and diversity across the NHS.

### [NHS IMPACT][34]

Delivering continuous improvement across the NHS.

### [NHS @home][35]

Providing better connected, more personalised care in homes and care homes.

## We lead the NHS in England to deliver high quality services for all

If you are looking for information about health conditions and NHS services please visit
[NHS.uk][16].

[My Planned Care][17] gives you advice and support while you wait and helps you to prepare for your
hospital consultation, treatment, or surgery.

[NHS league tables][18] provide a view of how NHS trusts are performing in key services including
urgent and emergency care, elective services, mental health and more.

[[Doctor examining a patient]][19]

## [The best of the NHS][20]

Every day, NHS colleagues across the country are delivering outstanding care in new and innovative
ways. Discover some of the [best work happening in the NHS][21] right now.

[[A nurse stands by a hospital bed talking to a patient]][22]

## [Medium Term Planning Framework - delivering change together 2026/27 to 2028/29][23]

The [Medium Term Planning Framework – delivering change together 2026/27 to 2028/29][24] is the
NHS’s most ambitious plan in a generation, setting out how waiting times will be dramatically
reduced and local care restored over the next 3 years while resetting the foundations to deliver the
10 Year Health Plan.

### [Digital transformation][25]

Helping health and care professionals communicate better.

### [Elective care][26]

How we are improving experience and giving people choice and control for elective care services.

### [Workforce][27]

How we can put the NHS workforce on a sustainable footing and meet future challenges.

### [Mental health][28]

Improving outcomes and experiences of people with mental health problems.

### [Integrated care][29]

Giving people the support they need and removing disjointed care.

### [Cancer][30]

Making sure everyone with cancer receives care, support and treatment.

### [Urgent and emergency care][31]

Ensuring patients get the right care whenever they need it.

### [Primary care][32]

Offering patients a wider choice of personalised health services.

### [Health inequalities improvement][33]

Tackling health inequalities and advancing equality and diversity across the NHS.

### [NHS IMPACT][34]

Delivering continuous improvement across the NHS.

### [NHS @home][35]

Providing better connected, more personalised care in homes and care homes.

  ### Fresenius Opens Innovation Center for Medical Nutrition in Bad Homburg

* Brief News
  
  ### AI assistant enhances access to Investor Relations information
  
  Today, Fresenius has launched the AI-powered assistant – “AskFRE” – on its Investor Relations (IR)
  website, marking an important step in advancing its digital capital markets communications. The
  solution is a joint initiative of the Fresenius AI Center of Excellence and the Investor Relations
  team.With AskFRE, visitors can now interact with an integrated AI chatbot that provides direct
  answers to capital market-relevant information. This includes financial results, company updates
  and other IR content – based exclusively on publicly available Fresenius disclosures.In an
  increasingly fast-paced and data-driven environment, digital investor relations play a key role in
  delivering timely, transparent and stakeholder-focused communication. AskFRE supports this
  ambition by enabling more intuitive access to financial information and tailored user
  interactions, while reinforcing the consistency and accessibility of Fresenius’ disclosures.With
  AskFRE, Fresenius underscores its commitment to advancing a best in class digital investor
  relations experience.AskFRE is now available: https://www.fresenius.com/AskFRE-Your-IR-Assistant
  
   
  
  May 26, 2026 · Fresenius

* [ #FutureFresenius is paying off: S&P Global Ratings revises outlook for Fresenius SE from stable
  to positive ][112]
  
  ### #FutureFresenius is paying off: S&P Global Ratings revises outlook for Fresenius SE from
  ### stable to positive
  
  S&P Global Ratings (S&P), a globally recognized credit rating agency today revised its credit
  outlook for Fresenius SE from stable to positive.
  
  April 08, 2026 · Fresenius
* Brief News
  
  ### Fresenius publishes 2025 Annual Report – REJUVENATE: Delivering accelerated performance for
  ### long-term value creation
  
  Today, Fresenius published its 2025 Annual Report. As announced in late February 2026, 2025 marked
  another strong year of performance and the launch of the current phase of the #FutureFresenius
  strategy: Rejuvenate. Despite headwinds, the healthcare group achieved its outlook, which was
  raised twice during the year. Group revenue before special items rose to €22.6 billion, with
  organic growth of 7%, while constant currency Core EPS (excluding FMC) increased by 12%. “Over the
  past three years, we have successfully implemented our #FutureFresenius strategy and created a new
  Fresenius that is innovative, relevant, resilient, and adaptable. At the same time, we have
  significantly bolstered our company’s economic strength. We aim to build on this strong
  foundation,” said Michael Sen, Chairman of the Management Board of Fresenius. The 2025 Annual
  Report demonstrates how Fresenius is creating sustainable value for all stakeholders by executing
  its #FutureFresenius strategy. It includes the Sustainability Statement in accordance with the
  European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS), and is available as a PDF and as an
  interactive online version in German and English. The online report features additional business
  stories and includes a video statement from CEO Michael Sen.
  
   
  
  March 25, 2026 · Fresenius

  ### AI assistant enhances access to Investor Relations information
  
  Today, Fresenius has launched the AI-powered assistant – “AskFRE” – on its Investor Relations (IR)
  website, marking an important step in advancing its digital capital markets communications. The
  solution is a joint initiative of the Fresenius AI Center of Excellence and the Investor Relations

  answers to capital market-relevant information. This includes financial results, company updates
  and other IR content – based exclusively on publicly available Fresenius disclosures.In an
  increasingly fast-paced and data-driven environment, digital investor relations play a key role in
  delivering timely, transparent and stakeholder-focused communication. AskFRE supports this
  ambition by enabling more intuitive access to financial information and tailored user

* Brief News
  
  ### Fresenius publishes 2025 Annual Report – REJUVENATE: Delivering accelerated performance for
  ### long-term value creation
  
  Today, Fresenius published its 2025 Annual Report. As announced in late February 2026, 2025 marked
  another strong year of performance and the launch of the current phase of the #FutureFresenius
  strategy: Rejuvenate. Despite headwinds, the healthcare group achieved its outlook, which was
  raised twice during the year. Group revenue before special items rose to €22.6 billion, with
  organic growth of 7%, while constant currency Core EPS (excluding FMC) increased by 12%. “Over the
  past three years, we have successfully implemented our #FutureFresenius strategy and created a new
  Fresenius that is innovative, relevant, resilient, and adaptable. At the same time, we have
  significantly bolstered our company’s economic strength. We aim to build on this strong
  foundation,” said Michael Sen, Chairman of the Management Board of Fresenius. The 2025 Annual
  Report demonstrates how Fresenius is creating sustainable value for all stakeholders by executing
  its #FutureFresenius strategy. It includes the Sustainability Statement in accordance with the
  European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS), and is available as a PDF and as an
  interactive online version in German and English. The online report features additional business
  stories and includes a video statement from CEO Michael Sen.

# You Can Thrive with Kidney Disease. We Can Help.

Look after your kidney health and keep the lifestyle you love. Get education, support, and the
highest quality kidney care to help you feel your best.

[I have kidney disease][102][I'm preparing for dialysis][103][I'm on dialysis now][104]

## More freedom starts right at home

Home dialysis may offer more flexibility, fewer food restrictions, and less medications. Learn more
so you can feel confident choosing a treatment option that fits your life.
[Learn more][105]
[[hat]][106]

## Free education for your kidney health

Take control of your kidney health — whether you're newly diagnosed, working to slow progression, or
exploring treatment options. Learn at your own pace or join a small group class.
[Get started][107]

## Manage your summer thirst

Managing your fluids in the heat of summer will help you feel your best. Find the shade and wear
loose, lightweight clothes to stay cool and tame your thirst.
[Get tips][108]

## Care made for you

Your doctor personalizes your prescription for your body's needs. Finishing each dialysis session as
prescribed by your doctor gives you the full benefit.
[Learn more][109]

## Try this kidney-friendly recipe today

Salmon tacos served with an easy-to-make side of slaw makes for a filling- and fast-weeknight
dinner. If you prefer more heat, add a pinch or two of chipotle chili powder or cayenne along with
the chili powder.
[Get recipe][110]

# You Can Thrive with Kidney Disease. We Can Help.

Look after your kidney health and keep the lifestyle you love. Get education, support, and the
highest quality kidney care to help you feel your best.

[I have kidney disease][102][I'm preparing for dialysis][103][I'm on dialysis now][104]

## More freedom starts right at home

Home dialysis may offer more flexibility, fewer food restrictions, and less medications. Learn more
so you can feel confident choosing a treatment option that fits your life.
[Learn more][105]
[[hat]][106]

## Free education for your kidney health

Take control of your kidney health — whether you're newly diagnosed, working to slow progression, or
exploring treatment options. Learn at your own pace or join a small group class.
[Get started][107]

## Manage your summer thirst

Managing your fluids in the heat of summer will help you feel your best. Find the shade and wear
loose, lightweight clothes to stay cool and tame your thirst.
[Get tips][108]

## Care made for you

Your doctor personalizes your prescription for your body's needs. Finishing each dialysis session as
prescribed by your doctor gives you the full benefit.
[Learn more][109]

## Try this kidney-friendly recipe today

Salmon tacos served with an easy-to-make side of slaw makes for a filling- and fast-weeknight
dinner. If you prefer more heat, add a pinch or two of chipotle chili powder or cayenne along with
the chili powder.
[Get recipe][110]
[
[stages]
][111]
Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is divided into five stages
Kidney disease is a progressive disease, meaning your kidney function may decline over time.
Understanding which stage of kidney disease you are in is key to keeping your kidneys as healthy

## Non-Toxic Therapies That Target Cancer Cells

Patient-Centered Integrative & Alternative Cancer Treatment Center

Take the first step toward integrative cancer care. Contact Hope4Cancer to schedule a complimentary
consultation and receive a personalized treatment plan tailored to individual diagnosis and goals.

Play Video [Dr. Tony Jimenez speaking with a doctor at Hope4Cancer] Your browser does not support
the video tag.

Hope4Cancer Treatment Centers provide personalized, non-toxic alternative cancer treatment at two
world-class facilities in Cancun and Playas de Tijuana, Mexico. Since 2000, the board-certified
medical team led by founder Antonio Jimenez, M.D., N.D., has treated thousands of patients from over
100 countries, offering more integrative cancer therapies under one roof than any other center in
the world.

Integrative Cancer Treatment Rooted in the 7 Key Principles

Every treatment program at Hope4Cancer follows the 7 Key Principles of Cancer Therapy, a
comprehensive clinical framework that addresses cancer from multiple angles simultaneously. Rather
than focusing solely on the tumor, this approach treats the whole person, targeting cancer cells
with non-toxic therapies while simultaneously restoring immune function, optimizing nutrition,
supporting detoxification, rebalancing the microbiome, providing oxygenation therapy, and addressing
emotional and spiritual well-being.

Non-Toxic Therapies That Target Cancer Cells

The Hope4Cancer protocol includes Sono-Photo Dynamic Therapy (SPDT), Photo Dynamic Therapy Plus
using advanced laser technology, bio-immunotherapy, hyperthermia, pulsed electromagnetic field
therapy (PEMF), ozone therapy, IV nutrient infusions, and many additional modalities. Each therapy
is selected for its ability to selectively target malignant cells while leaving healthy tissue
unharmed, avoiding the debilitating side effects commonly associated with conventional chemotherapy
and radiation.

Immune System Restoration and Support

## Non-Toxic Therapies That Target Cancer Cells

Patient-Centered Integrative & Alternative Cancer Treatment Center

Take the first step toward integrative cancer care. Contact Hope4Cancer to schedule a complimentary
consultation and receive a personalized treatment plan tailored to individual diagnosis and goals.

Hope4Cancer Treatment Centers provide personalized, non-toxic alternative cancer treatment at two
world-class facilities in Cancun and Playas de Tijuana, Mexico. Since 2000, the board-certified
medical team led by founder Antonio Jimenez, M.D., N.D., has treated thousands of patients from over
100 countries, offering more integrative cancer therapies under one roof than any other center in
the world.

Integrative Cancer Treatment Rooted in the 7 Key Principles

Every treatment program at Hope4Cancer follows the 7 Key Principles of Cancer Therapy, a
comprehensive clinical framework that addresses cancer from multiple angles simultaneously. Rather
than focusing solely on the tumor, this approach treats the whole person, targeting cancer cells
with non-toxic therapies while simultaneously restoring immune function, optimizing nutrition,
supporting detoxification, rebalancing the microbiome, providing oxygenation therapy, and addressing
emotional and spiritual well-being.

Non-Toxic Therapies That Target Cancer Cells

The Hope4Cancer protocol includes Sono-Photo Dynamic Therapy (SPDT), Photo Dynamic Therapy Plus
using advanced laser technology, bio-immunotherapy, hyperthermia, pulsed electromagnetic field
therapy (PEMF), ozone therapy, IV nutrient infusions, and many additional modalities. Each therapy
is selected for its ability to selectively target malignant cells while leaving healthy tissue
unharmed, avoiding the debilitating side effects commonly associated with conventional chemotherapy
and radiation.

Immune System Restoration and Support

The proprietary Sunivera Bio-Immunotherapy Protocol combines a macrophage activating factor (MAF)
with synergistic nutraceuticals to modulate both innate and adaptive immune responses. This
protocol, developed from 25 years of research at leading institutions, helps restore the immune
system's natural cancer-fighting capabilities, which are often compromised by the disease itself or
by prior conventional treatments.

World-Class Cancer Treatment Centers

Hope4Cancer operates two strategically located treatment centers on the Pacific and Caribbean coasts
of Mexico. Both facilities provide access to cutting-edge therapies and technologies in
healing-focused environments.

[Schedule a Free Consultation][70]

## What Makes
## Hope4Cancer Different

Patients and caregivers choose Hope4Cancer for its comprehensive, personalized approach to cancer
care. The standard 3-week treatment program includes over 200 therapy sessions, lodging for the
patient and a companion, all meals, transportation to and from the clinic, a 3-month home program
with supplies, and follow-up visits. The medical team designs each plan individually based on the
patient's diagnosis, cancer type, stage, and personal health goals.

### Alternative Cancer Treatments

At Hope4Cancer, true healing goes beyond treating disease—it’s about caring for the individual. We
offer more natural cancer therapies under one roof than anywhere in the world, including
bio-immunotherapies, sound and light therapies, and more, giving patients expanded options for
holistic healing.

Your care is entrusted to our board-certified integrative oncology team, blending experience in
alternative medicine, homeopathy, nutrition, rehabilitation therapy, and emotional healing. Driven
by compassion and innovation, our specialists become more than providers—they become family, guiding
you with personalized, integrative care.

#### Detailed Market Analysis

The pharmaceutical industry is undergoing a remarkable digital transformation, supported by concrete
market research and verified statistics. The scale of this transformation is evidenced by the
pharmaceutical digital platform market’s projected growth from $4.92 billion in 2023 to $34.12
billion by 2032, representing a robust CAGR of 24.35%. This growth is driven by widespread cloud
adoption, with approximately 80% of pharmaceutical companies already utilizing cloud computing
solutions and 95% expected to be fully cloud-operational within two years.

The transformation is happening across multiple dimensions, with web-based solutions dominating at
72.27% market share and AI-driven engagement representing 27.05% of patient engagement solutions.
Quality management systems are also evolving, with the market expected to grow from $1.87 billion in
2024 to $3.85 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 12.99%. This digital evolution is particularly strong in
North America, which holds a 43.6% share in patient engagement solutions and 39% of the quality
management software market. Implementation timelines vary by solution complexity, ranging from 3-6
months for modular SaaS deployments to 9-18 months for full-suite implementations, reflecting the
industry’s methodical approach to digital adoption while maintaining compliance with regulatory
requirements.

[Ben Rapaport]

## Every project still starts with the same manual work

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

# Why Choose UT MD Anderson

Every day, people like you choose UT MD Anderson for cancer treatment. But it’s more than our
decades of experience, top national rankings and leadership in cancer prevention that set us apart.
It goes beyond our groundbreaking research and innovative clinical care that provide new therapies
years before they become standard in the community. It’s because we put all of our focus on you.

# Why Choose UT MD Anderson

Every day, people like you choose UT MD Anderson for cancer treatment. But it’s more than our
decades of experience, top national rankings and leadership in cancer prevention that set us apart.
It goes beyond our groundbreaking research and innovative clinical care that provide new therapies
years before they become standard in the community. It’s because we put all of our focus on you.

# About Orbus

## Orbus Therapeutics is dedicated to developing products that treat rare diseases for which there
## are few, if any, effective therapies.

We at Orbus are committed to bringing innovative products to the extremely under served patients
affected by rare diseases.  We are focused and passionate about bringing a more positive outcome to
patients facing life threatening or significantly life altering diseases.

Currently Orbus Therapeutics is working to develop and commercialize eflornithine in North America
and Europe.

[
][18]

### TEAM

Our team is committed to improving the health and quality of life for patients with rare diseases. 

[
][19]

### Patients

Orbus Therapeutics is developing products for patients fighting   diseases that affect only a small
percentage of the population.

[
[iStock_000067435779_Large.jpg]
][20]

### [clinical results][21]

Our [STELLAR Study][22]in patients with grade 3 astrocytoma completed in 2024.  [See results
here][23].

Owler's exclusive company and industry insights make it easy to find competitors, leads, and
up-to-date news – so you can optimize your prospecting and sales results.

## For business professionals who want a serious competitive advantage

Owler Pro gives you access to premium features that keep your business in the loop about relevant
company, competitor, and industry news – so you can find qualified leads, improve your outreach, and
build better relationships with your customers.

**Follow an unlimited amount of companies relevant to your business needs**

**Discover new accounts, industry trends, and more**

**Get the latest news updates to stay ahead**

## For people who want an easier way to follow up to 5 companies that matter to them

Join Owler’s active community of 5 million+ business professionals and get exclusive insights about
competitors, prospects, and market updates that are only available to Owler users – so you can
ensure you stay ahead of the competition.

**Find detailed company information**

**Discover your closest competitors**

**Get real-time alerts and daily emails about relevant company and market news**

[ Learn about Owler Community ][64]

## What makes Owler different?

Discover your direct and indirect competitors with Owler's exclusive competitor graph.

Search accurate private and public company data for over 20 million companies.

Create targeted lists to get daily, personalized emails and alerts about news and companies that
matter to you.

Access detailed company data, including revenue, employee count, funding history, acquisitions,
news, and more.

Filter Owler’s entire database by revenue, sector, location, employee count, and public/private
company status.

A new standard is reshaping global pharmaceutical logistics. Discover how validated
temperature-controlled corridors enhance compliance, reduce risk, and protect product integrity
across every mile.

[Read More][92]
[Qualified Temperature-Controlled Corridors: The Future is Here]

## Inside the Shifting Role of Pharma 3PLs: Resilience, Regulation, and the Road Ahead

Sector leaders explore how third-party logistics providers are adapting to advanced therapies,
tighter regulations, digital transformation, and expanding cold chain demands.

[Read More][93]
[Inside the Shifting Role of Pharma 3PLs: Resilience, Regulation, and the Road Ahead]

## The Broken Business Model Driving America’s Pharmacy Deserts

Community pharmacies are being squeezed out of local markets, creating pharmacy deserts that raise
costs, reduce access, and strain the healthcare system.

[Read More][94]
[The Broken Business Model Driving America’s Pharmacy Deserts]

These hubs can streamline access, reduce friction across reimbursement and logistics, and improve
outcomes, as the CGT pipeline expands and patient demand accelerates.

### **О журнале**

«Фарматека» – рецензируемый научно-практический медицинский журнал, адресованный терапевтам,
педиатрам, кардиологам, эндокринологам, гастроэнтерологам, пульмонологам, дерматологам,
акушерам-гинекологам, урологам, онкологам, неврологам, ревматологам и врачам других специальностей.

Журнал «Фарматека» издается с 1994 года Начиная с первых номеров журнала на его страницах
публикуется информация о современных лекарственных средствах, их терапевтическом действии,
фармакокинетике и фармакодинамике, побочных эффектах, предназначенная для практикующих врачей;
освещаются последние достижения медицинской науки и техники, значимые клинические исследования
лекарственных средств, итоги международных и российских конгрессов и конференций.

С 2002 по 2017 год редакционный совет возглавлял член-корр. РАМН Юрий Борисович Белоусов, в совет
вошел ряд ведущих российских специалистов. Читательский круг журнала расширяется – издание читают
практикующие врачи, руководители медицинских учреждений и ВУЗов, НИИ, заведующие кафедрами, студенты
и соискатели.

В состав Редакционной коллегии журнала «Фарматека» входят ведущие российские специалисты основных
областей клинической медицины – 64 докторов медицинских наук. Все они принимают активное участие в
создании журнала и подтвердили согласие на вхождение в Редакционный совет.

Все номера журнала тематические и посвящены отдельным областям клинической медицины. Журнал выходит
с периодичностью 10 номеров в год. Объем полноцветного номера в среднем составляет 160–280 полос.
Тираж журнала превышает 25 тыс. экземпляров. Тираж сертифицирован Национальной тиражной службой.
Журнал «Фарматека» рассылается по подписке, распространяется на всех медицинских конгрессах, съездах
и конференциях на территории РФ, а также на обучающих циклах для врачей и студентов.

Журнал выпускается по следующим основным тематикам: Оториноларингология, Акушерство и гинекология,
Онкология, лучевая терапия, Урология и андрология, Внутренние болезни, Эндокринология, Кардиология,
Педиатрия, Инфекционные болезни, Дерматовенерология, Неврология, Ревматология, Пульмонология,
Восстановительная медицина, спортивная медицина, лечебная физкультура, курортология и физиотерапия,
Фармакология, клиническая фармакология. В журнале «Фарматека» публикуются оригинальные статьи,
клинические разборы, обзоры и лекции, посвященные наиболее актуальным проблемам фармакотерапии,
подготовленные ведущими специалистами соответствующих областей медицины.

Журнал «Фарматека» призван предоставлять читателям – широкому кругу врачей и научных медицинских
работников – наиболее актуальную информацию о результатах клинических исследований и новых, в т.ч.
инновационных, методах диагностики и лечения.

Журнал входит в перечень изданий, рекомендованных Высшей аттестационной комиссией (ВАК).

Ежегодно в рамках журнала «Фарматека» под редакцией М.Б. Анциферова - Главный внештатный специалист
эндокринолог Департамента здравоохранения города Москвы, главный врач ГБУЗ «Эндокринологический
диспансер Департамента здравоохранения города Москвы», доктор медицинских наук, профессор,
выпускается сборник избранных научных статей по эндокринологии «Современные аспекты фармакотерапии
эндокринных заболеваний». Сборник приурочен к Московскому городскому съезду эндокринологов.

### **О журнале**

«Фарматека» – рецензируемый научно-практический медицинский журнал, адресованный терапевтам,
педиатрам, кардиологам, эндокринологам, гастроэнтерологам, пульмонологам, дерматологам,
акушерам-гинекологам, урологам, онкологам, неврологам, ревматологам и врачам других специальностей.

Журнал «Фарматека» издается с 1994 года Начиная с первых номеров журнала на его страницах
публикуется информация о современных лекарственных средствах, их терапевтическом действии,
фармакокинетике и фармакодинамике, побочных эффектах, предназначенная для практикующих врачей;

лекарственных средств, итоги международных и российских конгрессов и конференций.

вошел ряд ведущих российских специалистов. Читательский круг журнала расширяется – издание читают
практикующие врачи, руководители медицинских учреждений и ВУЗов, НИИ, заведующие кафедрами, студенты
и соискатели.

областей клинической медицины – 64 докторов медицинских наук. Все они принимают активное участие в
создании журнала и подтвердили согласие на вхождение в Редакционный совет.

Ежегодно в рамках журнала «Фарматека» под редакцией М.Б. Анциферова - Главный внештатный специалист
эндокринолог Департамента здравоохранения города Москвы, главный врач ГБУЗ «Эндокринологический
диспансер Департамента здравоохранения города Москвы», доктор медицинских наук, профессор,
выпускается сборник избранных научных статей по эндокринологии «Современные аспекты фармакотерапии
эндокринных заболеваний». Сборник приурочен к Московскому городскому съезду эндокринологов.

С 2020 г. по настоящее время главный редактор Сычев Дмитрий Алексеевич - доктор медицинских наук,
профессор, профессор РАН, академик РАН, заслуженный деятель науки, научный руководитель Центра
геномных исследований мирового уровня «Центр предиктивной генетики, фармакогенетики и
персонализированной терапии» ФГБНУ РНЦХ им. акад. Б.В. Петровского Минобрнауки, заведующий кафедрой
клинической фармакологии и терапии им. академика Б.Е. Вотчала РМАНПО Минздрава, г. Москва,

# Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Treat cancer as a fungus
[dr tullio simoncini]

#### Dr. Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Dr. Tullio Simoncini, – oncologist from Rome, Italy – has pioneered sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3)
therapy as a means to treat cancer. The fundamental theory behind this treatment lies in the fact
that, despite a number of variable factors, the formation and spreading of tumors is simply the
result of the presence of a fungus.

[more][7]
[simoncini sodium bicarbonate iv]

#### Sodium Bicarbonate

Sodium bicarbonate, unlike other anti-fungal remedies to which the fungus can become immune, is
extremely diffusible and retains its ability to penetrate the tumor, due to the speed at which the
sodium bicarbonate disintegrates the tumor. This speed makes fungi’s adaptability impossible,
rendering it defenseless.

[more][8]

## General information

[dr tulklio simoncini rome italy]

#### About Dr. Simoncini

Tullio Simoncini is a roman doctor specialising in oncology, diabetology and in metabolic disorders.
He has a strong opposition to any type of intellectual conformity, which is often based on
suppositions without foundation or worse, on lies and falsities.

[sodium bicarbonate IV solution]

#### Sodium bicarbonate

The fundamental reason and the motives that suggest a therapy with sodium bicarbonate against
tumours is that, although with the concurrence of a myriad of variable concausal factors – the
development and the local and remote proliferation of these tumours has a cause that is exclusively
fungin.

[candida albicans]

#### Candida Albicans

Candida in cancer patients is usually interpreted as a consequence of the weakening and of the
exhaustion of the organism because of neoplastic lesions. But candida is not a post hoc but an ante
hoc cause.

[treatment-protocols]

#### Treatment protocols

Dr. Simoncini’s methods have cured people for over 25 years. Many of his patients recovered
completely from cancer, even in cases where official oncology had given up.
The best way to try to eliminate a tumour is to bring it into contact with sodium bicarbonate, as
closely as possible.

sodium bicarbonate.

## You control your data. Always.

Your identity is never shared. De-identified insights — only from what you choose to contribute —
help fund rare disease research and keep this platform free for every patient who needs it.

1
Vault 1 — Identity

Your name and contact info — stored separately, never joined to your health records, never shared
with any partner under any circumstances.

2
Vault 2 — Health Data

Symptoms, diagnoses, and records — linked only by a random ID. No path back to your identity.
HIPAA-aligned, row-level security enforced at the database layer.

3
Vault 3 — Analytics

Fully de-identified aggregate insights — contributed only with your explicit consent. Small groups
are never reported, preventing re-identification in rare disease populations.

## Frequently asked questions

About UniteRare, how the platform works, and how we protect your data

Is UniteRare free for patients and caregivers?

Yes. Every tool — disease navigation, symptom-based diagnosis assistance, FDA treatment search,
clinical trial matching, specialist lookup, and support program finder — is free for patients and
caregivers. No login is required to browse; login is required for personalized tools like Diagnosis
Assist.

Can UniteRare diagnose my rare disease?

No. UniteRare is a decision-support platform, not a medical provider. Our diagnosis-assist tool
ranks candidate rare diseases against your symptoms and helps you find the right specialists — but
only a qualified clinician can make a medical diagnosis.

How many rare diseases does UniteRare cover?

UniteRare covers over 11,000 rare diseases sourced from Orphanet, OMIM, and the FDA's
orphan-designation registry. Every disease page links back to its primary authoritative sources so
patients and clinicians can verify details.

Who reviews the medical information on UniteRare?

Content is aggregated from primary sources (Orphanet, OMIM, NIH, ClinicalTrials.gov, FDA label data)
and verified through an automated QC pipeline against those sources. The full review process is
documented in our Editorial Policy. Named clinical advisor bios are added as they join.

Is my health data private?

Yes. UniteRare uses a three-vault architecture — identity data is stored separately from health data
and linked only by a random ID. No data is shared with pharmaceutical partners or any third party
without your explicit consent. HIPAA-aligned row-level security is enforced at the database layer.

Can UniteRare help me find a specialist for my rare disease?

Yes. We track more than 43,000 verified clinicians and research centers, cross-referenced with

evidence-based appeal letters citing FDA label data, published clinical guidelines, and applicable
state regulations. It is free for patients and is a drafting aid — not a substitute for legal
advice.

How do I find a clinical trial for my disease?

to those actively recruiting for your disease, age, and location. Every trial links to its
ClinicalTrials.gov record for full eligibility criteria.

## You control your data. Always.

Your identity is never shared. De-identified insights — only from what you choose to contribute —
help fund rare disease research and keep this platform free for every patient who needs it.

1
Vault 1 — Identity

Your name and contact info — stored separately, never joined to your health records, never shared
with any partner under any circumstances.

2
Vault 2 — Health Data

Symptoms, diagnoses, and records — linked only by a random ID. No path back to your identity.
HIPAA-aligned, row-level security enforced at the database layer.

3
Vault 3 — Analytics

Fully de-identified aggregate insights — contributed only with your explicit consent. Small groups
are never reported, preventing re-identification in rare disease populations.

## Frequently asked questions

About UniteRare, how the platform works, and how we protect your data

Is UniteRare free for patients and caregivers?

Yes. Every tool — disease navigation, symptom-based diagnosis assistance, FDA treatment search,
clinical trial matching, specialist lookup, and support program finder — is free for patients and
caregivers. No login is required to browse; login is required for personalized tools like Diagnosis
Assist.

Can UniteRare diagnose my rare disease?

No. UniteRare is a decision-support platform, not a medical provider. Our diagnosis-assist tool
ranks candidate rare diseases against your symptoms and helps you find the right specialists — but
only a qualified clinician can make a medical diagnosis.

How many rare diseases does UniteRare cover?

UniteRare covers over 11,000 rare diseases sourced from Orphanet, OMIM, and the FDA's
orphan-designation registry. Every disease page links back to its primary authoritative sources so
patients and clinicians can verify details.

Who reviews the medical information on UniteRare?

Content is aggregated from primary sources (Orphanet, OMIM, NIH, ClinicalTrials.gov, FDA label data)
and verified through an automated QC pipeline against those sources. The full review process is
documented in our Editorial Policy. Named clinical advisor bios are added as they join.

Is my health data private?

Yes. UniteRare uses a three-vault architecture — identity data is stored separately from health data
and linked only by a random ID. No data is shared with pharmaceutical partners or any third party
without your explicit consent. HIPAA-aligned row-level security is enforced at the database layer.

#### Al Musella, DPM
#### President

Al Musella, DPM is a podiatrist in private practice in Hewlett, NY. He worked his way through school
as a computer programmer for medical research projects.

His interest in brain tumors started when his siter-in-law, Lana, was diagnosed with a gbm in 1992,
and was told it was hopeless. After surgery and radiation, the tumor was larger than before the
surgery and she was told she only had a few weeks left to live and there was no treatment options
for her other than a standard course of bcnu, which had no chance to help her for more than a few
extra weeks.

At that time, there was no world wide web! Version 1 of Netscape was released on December 15, 1994.
Al was an active member of Compuserve, and Compuserve had a cancer forum, with sections devoted to
the top 10 cancers (and no brain tumor section). Al created and ran the Brain Tumor Forum on
Compuserve in January 1993. He organized the members and had them help survey every major hospital
in the USA to find what treatments were available. That list was posted on Compuserve and became the
basis for the first internet database of clinical trials! At that time, the NCI only maintained
lists of clinical trials that they funded, not the trials sponsored by the drug companies or the
individual doctors or hospitals. (They do most now). And the only way to access them was to call the
NCI and they would mail them to you. The NCI invited Al to demonstrate his technology to them, and
the clinicaltrials.gov website was partially modelled after virtualtrials.org!

Al found a few clinical trials that would accept Lana, after being told by a few major brain tumor
centers that there were none. She did very well for a while, getting to see her 4 kids grow up, then
unfortunately died of a recurrence on Oct 25,2000. She lived over 8 years after being told she only
had a few weeks left. Many of those years were in excellent condition, with her taking care of her
kids, working, driving and enjoying life.

Ironically, Al's father was diagnosed with a GBM in 1999, a year after Al formed the Musella
Foundation. He died quickly, in about 3 months.

#### Al Musella, DPM
#### President

Al Musella, DPM is a podiatrist in private practice in Hewlett, NY. He worked his way through school
as a computer programmer for medical research projects.

His interest in brain tumors started when his siter-in-law, Lana, was diagnosed with a gbm in 1992,
and was told it was hopeless. After surgery and radiation, the tumor was larger than before the
surgery and she was told she only had a few weeks left to live and there was no treatment options
for her other than a standard course of bcnu, which had no chance to help her for more than a few
extra weeks.

At that time, there was no world wide web! Version 1 of Netscape was released on December 15, 1994.
Al was an active member of Compuserve, and Compuserve had a cancer forum, with sections devoted to
the top 10 cancers (and no brain tumor section). Al created and ran the Brain Tumor Forum on
Compuserve in January 1993. He organized the members and had them help survey every major hospital
in the USA to find what treatments were available. That list was posted on Compuserve and became the
basis for the first internet database of clinical trials! At that time, the NCI only maintained
lists of clinical trials that they funded, not the trials sponsored by the drug companies or the
individual doctors or hospitals. (They do most now). And the only way to access them was to call the
NCI and they would mail them to you. The NCI invited Al to demonstrate his technology to them, and
the clinicaltrials.gov website was partially modelled after virtualtrials.org!

Al found a few clinical trials that would accept Lana, after being told by a few major brain tumor
centers that there were none. She did very well for a while, getting to see her 4 kids grow up, then
unfortunately died of a recurrence on Oct 25,2000. She lived over 8 years after being told she only
had a few weeks left. Many of those years were in excellent condition, with her taking care of her
kids, working, driving and enjoying life.

Ironically, Al's father was diagnosed with a GBM in 1999, a year after Al formed the Musella
Foundation. He died quickly, in about 3 months.
